usageNote: 讲故事常用！先发生事情，然后他才解释，时间顺序感超强，口语书面都能用～

examples.en: He explained later that he had been stuck in traffic.
examples.zh: 他后来解释说自己堵车了。

examples.en: She was confused at first, but he explained later during dinner.
examples.zh: 她起初很困惑，但他在晚饭时后来解释了。
